observations: Orange gas cylinder with a black plastic protective mesh.
The brand name 'ULTIMATE' is printed on the side in white text.
A Standards Organisation of Nigeria (SON) logo is visible on the side.
The top of the cylinder, including the valve and any potential burner attachment, is not visible.
The bottom of the cylinder is visible and appears to be in okay condition.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows an 'ULTIMATE' branded cylinder, but no burner head is visible.

risks.proof: A photo of the top showing the burner assembly attached.
A photo of the manufacture or expiry date stamped on the metal shroud/handle.
A close-up photo of the valve and a video of it holding pressure.
A photo of the weight markings (e.g., 3kg, 6kg) on the handle.

proof_requests: Photo of the top of the cylinder showing the burner head and valve.
Photo of the date stamps and weight markings on the handle or shroud.
Photo of the entire unit to confirm it is a complete set.
response.reason: The seller claims it is a gas burner, but the only photo provided shows the side of a cylinder with the top cut off. Without seeing the burner head, valve, and expiry date, it cannot be safely or accurately priced.
